versions.changelog:
Initial release of coaching-memory skill.

- Enables AI agents to track goals and coaching progress using BlueColumn persistent vector memory.
- Provides endpoints to store, recall, and quickly note coaching context via API.
- Requires a BlueColumn API key (bc_live_*).
- Designed for use cases where agents coach users and need to manage longitudinal memory.
- Detailed setup instructions, API workflow, and documentation links included.
